b4/architecture_revision.json.note: the owner's review of 04385ae, R1: the architecture document's revision the tool tree was written against — PROVENANCE outside the identity's inventory (not a tool file), read by b4_thresholds.ARCHITECTURE_REVISION and held to the document's first line by the static pin test; a documentation-only revision changes this file and the document, never a tool file, and the method's identity does not move. Listed here like every file under b4/; not in the identity's import_table_sha256 projection.

b4/host/b4_carto.py.note: the observation cartographer (closed-book: single-bit pairs under one stimulus -> seen cells / presence / no effect seen / context-dependent / unknown; multi-bit pairs counted, never decomposed; no semantic claim), the operator's groups, the v3 draft's shape check, control X (the derangement rule and the shadow isomorphism derived from B3's control-X contract, re-aimed at the eight visible lanes), A0, D and the PRIVILEGED oracle view.; X-A: derangement_attempts (every attempt kept), relabel_genome, isomorphic_addresses (the full shadow contract under π), residual_structure (post hoc); the lane permutation kept as the symmetry test

b4/host/b4_controls.py.note: unit 2b-4a A: the X and D control seeds (sha256('b4-x-control-1|l|o') / ('b4-d-control-1|l|o')[:4], 32-bit ints, never bools); F's frozen view REBUILT from the base and the 21 probe records with a fresh cartographer and held to every record and to the result's final fields, after a replay with no finding, on a complete, learned, non-privileged F result under the formal source only; D as that view through shuffled_view once with the permutation reconstructed and the residual reported, identity or partition-preserving kept, never redrawn; verify_d_view for a recorded given view.

b4/host/b4_deadline.py.note: unit 2b-4a B: the soft monotonic deadline (time.monotonic; UTC only a timestamp): check() between work units raises StopWork; a started unit is never interrupted; the record carries seconds / elapsed / checks / first expiry.

b4/host/b4_engine.py.note: B2's (mu, lambda) = (4, 8), KMAX = 4 engine re-implemented over the FF universe with the execution boundary at every observation: the arms R / F (a seeded probe pass, then frozen; or a given view with its provenance) / O / X, DOMAIN termination (the measured prefix, the pending children, no further draw, observation, score, selection or learning, the generator not rolled back), the ledger with map versions and commitments, generation closes, the holdout once for a completed run. Provenance: the observation source's identity (hypothesis digest and fixture marker, certificate digest) bound into the result and every ledger entry; a given view kept with its provenance chain; a DOMAIN at the holdout keeps the search's champion without a holdout score.; X-A: arm X over relabelled addresses with its own control seed, π drawn before the base observation from the control generator, the shadow contract after every ingest, a control failure as its own event at a stated commit point, the residual structure post hoc

b4/host/b4_execution.py.note: the execution boundary: ObservationPort (observe and the addresses, nothing else), SpyPort, PublicTask, TerminalEvent / Terminated / OtherRefusal, observe_candidate (DOMAIN -> a terminal event with the state before the call; any other refusal by its name). The strict source-identity validator (provenance_findings: hypothesis, mapping and FABRIC fields, exact types, 64-hex digests), SourceRefusal, the finite refusal kinds and raise_refusal.

b4/host/b4_ff_hypothesis.py.note: the behaviour hypothesis loader: load() takes no path, reads the committed v0.3 file only against the pinned HYPOTHESIS_SHA256, holds the shape (validated enum readings; unknown only in clock_mode's latch context) and re-hashes every named source, always; any other document — a valid copy included — enters through fixture() / fixture_file() and is marked; the decode by equality with clock_mode per storage context and unknown readings reported. v0.3: the pointer and the pin rotated; no logic changed.

b4/host/b4_ff_mapping.py.note: the certificate mapping of one site, read from the committed certificate against its pinned digest (another file only with its digest given explicitly); address ranges, endpoint existence and site; each token's reading DIRECTION is the class's (every token direct but NOCLKINV, negated) and the row's negated / expected_value / transition must agree with it; the two readings of a shared bit must be complementary; the project's bit readings held to the certificate's specimen pairs.

b4/host/b4_ff_model.py.note: the simulated fabric: configuration + stimulus -> the EXECUTING SIDE's trace under a mapping and a hypothesis passed in separately; the decode and everything derived from it host-only (diagnose / step_diagnostics); validation of the configuration, every step as handed and the init step's context at the entry; a configuration outside the domain refused with the fixed code DOMAIN and no reason (never a specimen, a redraw condition or a map-update signal); fixtures truth / permuted / dropout and seven hypothesis swaps. Every Fabric carries a source descriptor (kind, effect digest, dropout digest and count, seed — digests only) in every trace header.

b4/host/b4_gate.py.note: unit 2b-4 (the gate-tool half; the owner's ruling of 2026-10-19 on gate tool versus production execution): the formal gate tool — judge (pure: the budget rule, the ten rows K1–K10 with method / value / threshold / status / reason, the verdict PASS / FAIL / invalid / incomplete; a valid complete failure FAIL, a contract break invalid, unfinished work incomplete, no B* / N leaving the dependent rows not assessable and the gate unable to PASS; the summary's own contract checked before anything is judged), the formal identity (the pinned gate label, S = 200, a production batch archive; fixture / synthetic judgements written with formal = false and a NOT A GATE RESULT standing), the gate report document (gate_report.json + its deterministic markdown rendering, bound by digest; typed validator), the gate directory under evidence/b4/gate/ (exclusive, no symlink, nothing overwritten; the self-validation by the verifier before the report is written — findings make the verdict invalid), run_gate (b4_sim.run_batch in mode gate, then the judgement), judge_batch (an existing gate or mechanics archive), judge_synthetic (Python API, b4-mech labels only), the production CLI (run: the pinned label and S = 200 only; judge: production archives on a clean tree only; no fixture / allow-dirty path). Running the production gate is withheld by the ruling. The owner's HOLD on 4cdc0c1 (R1 / R2): the summary contract made TOTAL on arbitrary decoded JSON (exact types — a bool is never an int, 64.0 never the budget 64; finite numbers; nested shapes before any index) and COHERENT (the at-B* copies bound to their per-budget originals, the ratios to the means through the harness's _ratio, the sign-test p to its counts, Cohen's d to its mean and variance with +inf's one encoding, the N scan ascending and bound to N / power, the fractions to their counts and S, the budget rule to its inputs); the document's identity fields validated before anything is read. The owner's second HOLD (a8f2da1): Cohen's d bound by MAGNITUDE to the value implied by its mean, population variance and S under the production sample-variance convention (implied_cohen_d; D_REL_TOL 1e-12, the archives agree to ~1e-16; the special cases S < 2 and zero variance exact); a numeric pre-pass (numeric_findings: every float finite, every int within ±2^63) before any canonical serialisation or arithmetic in the summary contract, the identity fields, the synthetic summary, the gate report and judge_batch; every copy / constant binding exact in type through _same (8.0 is never 8, true never 1); the count bounded by S_MAX. The owner's third HOLD (b49b2ec): the derived arithmetic guarded — implied_cohen_d checks the sample variance, its root and the quotient finite (an overflow or an underflow to zero is the special 'unrepresentable', named by _stat_findings and never compared); _ratio_findings checks its inputs finite and the quotient representable before any serialisation; the D_REL_TOL note rewritten as a consistency-check tolerance with its boundary limit disclosed (not the K5 threshold, no epsilon).

b4/host/b4_gate_stats.py.note: unit 2b-4a B: median / percentile / mean / cohen_d / sign_test_p / bootstrap_reject_rate / required_pairs copied VERBATIM from host/b2_gate.py (the source text of each held equal to the original's by read-only import in the tests; per-function digests of the copied source above); dependencies math / statistics / random only; required_pairs_scan = the same complete ascending scan with a deadline check before each N (identical numbers); encode_stat / finite_findings for JSON without NaN / Infinity (a +inf Cohen's d kept as a named special, never 0).

b4/host/b4_gate_verify.py.note: unit 2b-4: the independent verifier of a gate directory — the file set, the typed validator, the evidence binding (the batch archive's sim_report / seeds / manifest digests and identity, or the synthetic summary), the batch archive re-verified archive-wide by b4_sim_verify (deep), the judgement recomputed by b4_gate.judge and held row by row (budget rule, rows, formal, contract findings, verdict, standing, diagnostics), the markdown re-rendered and compared byte for byte; a report that recorded self-validation findings is never clean; a fresh-process CLI (exit 0 iff no finding).

b4/host/b4_gonogo.py.note: protocol v0.2.0 (choice 5): the engineering go / no-go policy of section 9.4 applied to an exploration archive — S = 32, B_go = 64, the one-sided exact sign test on Omega - R with positives > negatives and p <= 0.20, the seven judged conditional K9 medians >= 0.50, every planned pair complete else no decision; a cost policy record with its own validator, verifier and markdown; never a gate verdict or an authorisation.

b4/host/b4_k10.py.note: unit 2b-4a B: K10's driver — the two fixed backgrounds (0 and the salted generator's first uniform(1 << 21), equal ones kept), 2 x 210 four-corner units through b4_stats.four_corner with every corner's genome / score / observation kept, the per-seed max and outcome at tau = 2, a comparable = False return escalated at once to K10Invalid with the partial kept (never 'not comparable'), the deadline between units, the offline recompute.

b4/host/b4_k9.py.note: unit 2b-4a B: K9's fixed comparison set (section 9.3): the 64 backgrounds, the forced pairs (32 per slice-wide, 64 per per-element address; 1 184), applicability from the host decode of the two endpoints only (x5FF under a latch, sr_kind under a latch; storage_kind with presence), the differences by position and kind, the per-semantic / per-address counts (an empty denominator not assessable, never 100 %), the deadline between pairs, and the offline recompute from the kept grids.

b4/host/b4_landscape.py.note: the public task generator task-v0.1 (stimulus, mask, target, weights from the landscape seed alone; the all-zero base declared; the holdout stimulus its own derivation) and the scoring (None scores nothing, is counted, never moves the ceiling).

b4/host/b4_observe.py.note: unit 2b-4a B: the per-seed observation memo of K9 / K10 — (genome, stimulus digest) under ONE source identity held by provenance_findings; every unique observation kept whole (config digest, stimulus digest, provenance digest, trace digest, the full q grid); true port calls vs cache hits; DOMAIN propagates; enters no ledger.

b4/host/b4_protocol.py.note: protocol v0.2.0 (choice 6): the machine identity of the execution / judgement method, built from the tree's trusted inventory (every tool file held to this table's digest, the copied statistics by per-function digest, the thresholds table's digest without its source text, the task / K9 / K10 constants, the engine, every record schema by version and validator digest, the formal inputs, the labels); the document's revision carried as provenance and excluded from the digest and the equality; compare() names the differing components; an archive of another version is refused by name.

b4/host/b4_replay.py.note: replay as RE-EXECUTION: the engine run again from the declared inputs against a ledger-backed port that serves the recorded observations in order, raises the recorded refusal at its attempt and holds every call to the record; the whole result compared field by field; the authenticity limit stated (the execution sequence is proved, the observations' origin is bound, not re-derived). Validation total and type-exact before any use; refusals re-raised by their finite kind; a malformed record a named finding, an internal error reported as such.; X-A: π re-derived from the control seed and compared with the record, the control fields typed and X's only, a recorded control failure must reproduce

b4/host/b4_rng.py.note: the line's PRNG (xorshift64 over a 32-bit seed, uniform by rejection, partial Fisher-Yates sample) copied from b1_carto.Rng with a state() accessor added; behavioural equality held by b4/tests/test_b4_rng.py by import of the pinned original (read-only).

b4/host/b4_seeds.py.note: unit 2b-4a A: the seed anchor (sha256(label|anchor)[:4], the label beside the anchor, '|' in a label refused); the 38 historical exclusion sources of docs/b4_architecture.md section 9.2 read against their digests through TYPED field paths (no count / version / timestamp can be read as a seed); B2's EXCLUDED_SEEDS copied and held to the pinned file's text; B4's exposed literal values; the evidence/b4/sim/ registry of every archived set (a run directory without a valid seed record is refused); one pooled set; pair_seeds copied from host/b2_search.py (held equal to the original by import in the tests, read-only). Runtime imports no pinned module.

b4/host/b4_sim.py.note: unit 2b-4a C: the host-only exploration harness — a pre-flight that writes nothing on refusal (label b4-sim-<n>, a clean tree with no override, the formal source, the root's inputs at their pinned digests, every exclusion source, an output directory directly under evidence/b4/sim/ created exclusively); seeds.json then manifest.json then the first observation; per pair R > F > O > X > D > Omega > A0 on one worker, each RunResult written exclusively before its audit, the typed completion checks, replay, ledger recompute, given-view checks, D from F's rebuilt map, K7 prefixes, K9, K10, curves, the pair index, the HEAD / input checkpoint; fail-closed stops (invalid / incomplete) with STOPPED.json, a typed sim_report.json always and a pooled summary only when complete; values beside the section-9 thresholds, no verdict field; exit codes 0 / 1 / 2 / 3. Running it is a separate authorisation. Unit 2b-4 (the gate tool, 2026-10-19): mode "gate" (b4-gate-<n> labels, reached through b4_gate.py only; the exploration CLI unchanged), standing_for(label) — the gate's standing text for a gate label, the exploration's text (unchanged, as the archived summaries carry it) otherwise; summarise_batch takes the standing as a parameter; no constant changed.

b4/host/b4_sim_schema.py.note: unit 2b-4a C: typed validators (named findings, total over keys, type-exact scalars) for every file the harness writes — seeds, manifest, arm result (the engine's shape check), arm audit, controls, k7, k9, k10, curves, pair index, STOPPED, INIT_FAILED, the report (a summary only when complete; no verdict-like key) — applied before each write and offline over a run directory.

b4/host/b4_sim_verify.py.note: unit 2b-4a repair (the owner's HOLD on cdf2c53, F2 / F3 / F4): the archive-wide verifier of a run directory — the required file set of the recorded status and of every pair's state, no unlisted or duplicate file, every listed digest / size, seeds / manifest / report linkage, STOPPED exactly when not complete, every file against its typed validator with the pair's task bound, and (deep) every conclusion recomputed from the raw readouts on the formal model (arm re-audits, controls, K7 prefixes, K9 / K10, curves, the pooled summary); run by the batch on itself before the report is written; offline CLI; writes nothing; the authenticity limit of b4_replay stated. Second round (the owner's HOLD on f2c4bca, R1–R5): every record bound to the planned pair / role / seeds and the formal source, a complete pair's every arm re-audited whatever its recorded state, exact scalar types. Unit 2b-4: the report's standing bound to its label (standing_for) and the summary recomputed with it.

b4/host/b4_snapshot.py.note: unit 2b-4a A: K7 from the ledger alone, no engine / RunResult change — the map rebuilt under each arm's rule (O online; X relabelled through the recorded pi with a shadow on the true genome, the contract checked after every ingest against the record; F the base + 21 probes then frozen, later records held to the frozen version; given views and R not applicable, their records held to the given / absent map); O's B* prefix of exactly B + 1 records (base + B search), the four states summing to 21; the final fields held to the rebuild; the rebuilt relations for the archive.

b4/host/b4_stats.py.note: the four-corner interaction index and its four per-seed outcomes as a pure computation; tau a parameter with no default; every seed in the denominator.

b4/host/b4_target.py.note: protocol v0.2.0 (the owner's rulings of 2026-10-20, choices 2-3 and the target-setup contract): the per-pair target setup of task-v0.2 — the private plan (seeds, the planted flip-flop genome by the fixed rule, the stimulus digests) persisted before the first target call, each setup observation of the planted configuration through the execution port saved on return, the PublicTask (no seed, no planted genome, no private record) and task.json last; the offline reconstruction (setup_findings) from the kept records, the fabric never asked again.

b4/host/b4_thresholds.py.note: unit 2b-4a C: the machine table of docs/b4_architecture.md section 9's fixed thresholds, grid, anchor and control formulas, pinned field by field to the document's text by b4/tests/test_b4_thresholds.py; listed beside exploration values for reference; never a verdict.

b4/hypothesis/ff_behaviour_v0.2.json.note: status unverified; v0.2: machine-enum readings, clock_mode by storage context (the latch probe's finding), the domain rule, the initialisation event's allowed context, the executing-side / host-only split of the observation context; sources by kind — the vendor's UNISIM models by root + path + sha256 + the lines adopted, the certificate and docs/ff_latch_probe.md by path + sha256, the project's decode assumptions. 0.2.1: the domain_refusal and formal_input blocks. b4/tests/test_b4_gate.py.note: unit 2b-4: the judge on synthetic summaries (the PASS path; every row's FAIL on its own number; the boundaries written with an equal sign; +inf d; no B*; invalid / incomplete; the summary contract; the formal identity; the committed S = 32 report as a read-only reference), end to end on a hermetic copy (a valid FAIL archive without B*, a synthetic PASS, an invalid and an incomplete archive; the verifier in process and in a fresh process; the tampering negatives with digests refreshed, the coordinated tamper of the evidence caught by the deep re-verification; refusals and persistence; the production-only CLI). Production derivation guarded and asserted never reached. After the HOLD on 4cdc0c1: the synthetic summary built coherently from primitives; every row's FAIL produced coherently; the owner's six reproductions and one case per binding as invalid judgements; the totality fuzz (every node replaced by every foreign value: never an exception, a null always a finding); the refreshed-hash negatives and the invalid positive controls end to end. After the second HOLD: the fixture's d by the production convention (sample standard deviation); the magnitude test (a concrete 200-value sequence against the production function, the owner's boundary 0.4987…, the special cases, the coordinated two-copy edit, the tolerance); the alias test (the five numerically-equal float aliases, bool aliases, a huge integer, an infinite literal, a NaN, the int-leaf alias fuzz); the totality fuzz extended with the numeric edges; the end-to-end negatives extended (the coordinated d, two aliases, the huge integer and the infinite literal — the last two refused at the evidence boundary). After the third HOLD: the derived-arithmetic test (1a, 1b, the safe implied d, the two whole-summary cases through validator, judge and artifact); the tolerance-limit disclosure test (the owner's integer sequence with d exactly 0.5; both copies at 0.5 − 5e-13 pass the consistency check and flip K5 — a documented limit, the frozen threshold unchanged); two more end-to-end negatives.

b4/tests/test_b4_seeds.py.note: Unit 2b-4: the two historical-source tests no longer assume an empty exploration registry (the S = 32 exploration b4-sim-3 is archived under evidence/b4/sim/ since 5c08536): the registry is exactly the archived run directories, each read from its seeds.json, and their values are in the pool.
